name: Giskard
tagline: Giskard is an open-source AI quality testing platform that automatically scans LLMs and ML models for vulnerabilities such as hallucinations, bias, prompt injection, and data leakage. Teams integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to ensure model safety before deployment.
